messages.content: The condition review turned up a crate reading that has to be checked again at 10:00 tomorrow morning. I need to stay in St. Louis through that second check, so please move my return to Friday and extend the Cheshire through Friday morning. The site coordinator has arranged coverage for the Atlanta handoff.

I’ll coordinate both changes. Your current return is American AA 1847 connecting in Charlotte on Thursday morning under K4N7PC, and the Cheshire reservation ends today under CHS-804621. About what time do you expect to be free after Friday’s 10:00 a.m. check?
Allow ninety minutes for the check and notes. I could leave the museum around 11:45. I don’t want a departure that depends on racing to the airport.

With an 11:45 departure from the museum, I would plan on reaching STL around 12:15 p.m. The first workable American exchange leaves at 1:52 p.m., connects in Charlotte, and reaches Atlanta at 6:38 p.m. There is also a 3:10 p.m. American itinerary through Dallas arriving at 9:47 p.m. The 1:52 option allows about 1 hour 37 minutes at the airport and has a 58-minute connection in Charlotte.
The 1:52 flight is practical. Is the checked supply case still covered, and what does the change cost?

Yes. The checked supply case carries over to the Friday itinerary. Exchanging the Thursday ticket for the 1:52 p.m. departure adds $86.40, with no separate bag charge. The flights would be AA 2196 from STL to CLT and AA 763 from CLT to ATL.
Hold that while you check the hotel. They told me I could remain in the same room, but that Thursday night would have to be a separate reservation.

The Cheshire can add Thursday, October 15, in the same king room for $238.17 including taxes and mandatory fees. It must be booked under a new confirmation, but the front desk will link it to CHS-804621 and mark it as a continuous stay so you do not have to check out or move rooms. Friday checkout remains 11:00 a.m.
That works. Can they hold the suitcase and supply case after checkout until I leave for the airport?
Yes. Complimentary storage is available after the 11:00 a.m. checkout. I can add a note that you expect to collect both items at approximately 11:45 a.m. Friday before leaving for STL.
Please book the extra night with that note, then exchange the flight to the 1:52 option.

Before I complete both transactions: the hotel extension is $238.17, and the airline exchange is $86.40, for a combined additional charge of $324.57 to the payment method on file. The hotel extension is cancellable without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time today; after that, the full one-night amount is charged. The exchanged airfare follows the ticket’s existing change and cancellation terms. Shall I proceed?

Both changes are confirmed. The additional Cheshire night is booked for Thursday, October 15, under confirmation CHS-917304 for $238.17. It is linked to CHS-804621 as a continuous stay in the same king room, and the reservation notes storage of the suitcase and supply case after Friday’s 11:00 a.m. checkout. American has exchanged the return for Friday, October 16: AA 2196 departs STL at 1:52 p.m. and arrives CLT at 4:35 p.m.; AA 763 departs CLT at 5:33 p.m. and arrives ATL at 6:38 p.m. The checked supply case remains included. The flight change cost is $86.40, and the updated airline confirmation remains K4N7PC.
Give me one reconciled itinerary for the extension and Friday return.

Revised St. Louis itinerary: remain at the Cheshire through Friday morning. The original October 12-15 stay remains under CHS-804621, and Thursday night is separately confirmed under CHS-917304 for $238.17; the reservations are linked for the same king room with no checkout or room move on Thursday. Check out by 11:00 a.m. Friday, leave the suitcase and checked supply case with the front desk, complete the museum’s 10:00-11:30 a.m. crate check and notes, then collect both items around 11:45 a.m. and depart for STL. Return Friday, October 16, on American AA 2196, STL 1:52 p.m. to CLT 4:35 p.m., connecting to AA 763, CLT 5:33 p.m. to ATL 6:38 p.m., under K4N7PC. The supply case remains included. Total additional charge: $324.57 ($238.17 hotel and $86.40 airfare). The prior Thursday AA itinerary has been removed.
